schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "admin_audit_logs" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"username" TEXT NOT NULL,"role" TEXT NOT NULL,"action" TEXT NOT NULL,"action_name" TEXT NOT NULL,"target" TEXT,"ip" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCESS',"details" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "admin_sessions" ("token" TEXT NOT NULL,"user_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"username" TEXT NOT NULL,"role" TEXT NOT NULL,"name" TEXT NOT NULL,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"ip" TEXT,"user_agent" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("token"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "admin_users" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"username" TEXT NOT NULL,"password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"salt" TEXT NOT NULL,"role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin',"name" TEXT NOT NULL,"active" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"last_login_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("username"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_contacts" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"type" TEXT NOT NULL,"url" TEXT NOT NULL,"endpoint" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"code_hash" TEXT,"code_expires" DOUBLE PRECISION,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"verified_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"failures" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"last_error" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_contexts" ("context_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"fingerprint" TEXT,"issued" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY("context_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_credits" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"balance" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"held" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"total_deposited" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"total_spent" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"updated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("account_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_hits" ("fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL,"user_agent" TEXT,"first_seen" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"last_seen" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"hits" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"last_path" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("fingerprint"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_interests" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"task" TEXT NOT NULL,"task_norm" TEXT NOT NULL,"category" TEXT,"kind" TEXT,"auth_pref" TEXT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"last_checked" DOUBLE PRECISION,"recommended" TEXT,"best_score" DOUBLE PRECISION,"active" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"hint" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("visitor_id","task_norm"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_marketing_permissions" ("watch_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"notice_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"requested_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"verified_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"withdrawn_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("watch_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_messages" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"role" TEXT NOT NULL,"channel" TEXT,"text" TEXT NOT NULL,"data" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_notifications" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"contact_id" BIGINT,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"kind" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"detail" TEXT,"items" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_outcomes" ("visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"success" BIGINT NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("visitor_id","resource_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_task_budgets" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL,"started" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"n" BIGINT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("key"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_task_destination_checks" ("watch_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"notice_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"confirmed_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"verified_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"destination_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("watch_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_task_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"watch_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"attempts" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"next_attempt" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"evidence" TEXT NOT NULL,"error" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("watch_id","evidence"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_task_permissions" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"watch_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"action" TEXT NOT NULL,"purpose" TEXT NOT NULL,"notice_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_task_watches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"task" TEXT NOT NULL,"protocol" TEXT,"channel" TEXT NOT NULL,"state" TEXT NOT NULL,"sealed" TEXT,"code_hash" TEXT,"code_expires" DOUBLE PRECISION,"verify_failures" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"verification_sent" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"last_event" DOUBLE PRECISION,"baseline" TEXT,"notice_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"authority" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revoked_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"last_checked" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"verified_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_test_reports" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT,"title" TEXT NOT NULL,"slug" TEXT,"kind" TEXT NOT NULL,"source" TEXT NOT NULL,"agent_name" TEXT NOT NULL,"agent_url" TEXT NOT NULL,"category" TEXT NOT NULL,"eval_grade" TEXT,"eval_score" DOUBLE PRECISION,"status_code" BIGINT,"latency_ms" DOUBLE PRECISION,"is_success" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"test_method" TEXT NOT NULL,"tool_name" TEXT,"input_wire" TEXT,"output_wire" TEXT,"summary" TEXT NOT NULL,"content_md" TEXT NOT NULL,"pros" TEXT NOT NULL,"cons" TEXT NOT NULL,"workflow_recommendation" TEXT,"tags" TEXT,"author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AI Verification Agent',"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"executed_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"execution_finished_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"connection_version_id" TEXT,"evidence_scope" TEXT,"creation_subject_key" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("creation_subject_key"),UNIQUE("slug"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_visitor_case_notes" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"actor" TEXT NOT NULL,"kind" TEXT NOT NULL,"body" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_visitor_cases" ("visitor_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',"owner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"next_followup" DOUBLE PRECISION,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL,"version" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,PRIMARY KEY("visitor_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_visitors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"token_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"name" TEXT,"channel" TEXT,"user_agent" TEXT,"fingerprint" TEXT,"lang" TEXT,"first_seen" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"last_seen" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"visits" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"visit_days" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"messages" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"tier" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',"notify" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"last_notified" DOUBLE PRECISION,"last_offset" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"last_results" TEXT,"nurture_stage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'onboarded',"last_nurture_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"last_tool_resource" BIGINT,"last_tool_name" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("token_hash"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_workflows" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"name" TEXT NOT NULL,"description" TEXT,"category" TEXT,"trigger_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',"steps" TEXT NOT NULL,"tags" TEXT,"is_active" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,"is_template" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Admin',"author_wallet" TEXT DEFAULT '',"parent_workflow_id" BIGINT,"forks_count" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"likes_count" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"runs_count" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"rating_avg" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "application_control_archives" ("domain" TEXT NOT NULL,"identity" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("domain","identity"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cancellation_requests" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"request_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"visitor_id" TEXT,"visitor_token_hash" TEXT,"token_masked" TEXT,"source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ftc_footer',"reason" TEXT,"ip" TEXT,"user_agent" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cancelled',"reactivated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"notes" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("request_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "capability_approvals" ("version_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"contract_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"tool" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("version_id","contract_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "capability_eligibility" ("resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"version_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"outcome" TEXT NOT NULL,"executed_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("resource_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "capability_evidence" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"version_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"scope" TEXT NOT NULL,"outcome" TEXT NOT NULL,"started" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"finished" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"recorded" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"code" TEXT,"operation_ref" TEXT,"contract_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',"validator_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"dataset_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"cases" BIGINT NOT NULL,"successes" BIGINT NOT NULL,"artifact_hash" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("version_id","scope","operation_ref","contract_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clearing_ledger" ("tx_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"account_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"tool_name" TEXT NOT NULL,"amount" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"sla_verified" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"receipt" TEXT,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"settled_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("tx_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "connection_agents" ("resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"agent_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("resource_id"),UNIQUE("agent_ref"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "connection_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"binding_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"schema_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"profile_version" TEXT NOT NULL,"schema_complete" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("resource_id","binding_hash","schema_hash","profile_version"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "crawl_runs" ("at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"source" TEXT NOT NULL,"ok" BIGINT NOT NULL,"seen" BIGINT,"new" BIGINT,"deactivated" BIGINT,"seconds" DOUBLE PRECISION,"error" TEXT,"mode" TEXT,"changed" BIGINT,"unchanged" BIGINT,"pages" BIGINT,"registry_missing" BIGINT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_account_deletions" ("customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"requested" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("customer_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_bff_tokens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"token_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"session_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"purpose" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"revoked" DOUBLE PRECISION,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("token_hash"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_credit_acceptances" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"version" TEXT NOT NULL,"digest" TEXT NOT NULL,"session_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_credit_accounts" ("customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"balance" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("customer_id"),CHECK(balance>=0))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_credit_artifacts" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"artifact_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"bundle_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id","artifact_id","revision"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_credit_bundles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"downloaded" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_credit_events" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"event_key" TEXT NOT NULL,"delta" BIGINT NOT NULL,"balance" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("customer_id","event_key"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_credit_restore_blocks" ("customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("customer_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_identities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"issuer" TEXT NOT NULL,"subject_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"active" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"last_login" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("issuer","subject_hash"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_inquiries" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"inquiry_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',"name" TEXT NOT NULL,"email" TEXT NOT NULL,"subject" TEXT NOT NULL,"message" TEXT NOT NULL,"visitor_token" TEXT,"ip" TEXT,"user_agent" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',"admin_response" TEXT,"resolved_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"resolved_by" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("inquiry_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_oidc_flows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"browser_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"config_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"sealed" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"consumed" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_organization_audit" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT,"actor_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,"action" TEXT NOT NULL,"object_ref" TEXT,"revision" BIGINT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_organization_invitations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"recipient_customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"recipient_revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"role" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created_by" TEXT NOT NULL,"creator_link_revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"resolved" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_organizations" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"active" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created_by" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"archived" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_recovery_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_recovery_policies" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_recovery_requests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"target_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"config_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"revoked" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_task_outcome_restore_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_task_outcome_withdrawals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_task_outcomes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_workspace_audit" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"action" TEXT NOT NULL,"object_id" TEXT,"revision" BIGINT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_workspace_links" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"role" TEXT NOT NULL,"active" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id","customer_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "erc8004_tokens" ("chain" TEXT NOT NULL,"agent_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"uri_hash" TEXT,"uri" TEXT,"host" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"services" TEXT,"checked_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"next_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"error" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("chain","agent_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evidence_rollup_audit" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evidence_rollup_withdrawals" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"scope" TEXT NOT NULL,"source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id","scope","source_ref"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_control_events" ("revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"invoke_enabled" BIGINT NOT NULL,"workflow_enabled" BIGINT NOT NULL,"delivery_enabled" BIGINT NOT NULL,"admin_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("revision"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_controls" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"invoke_enabled" BIGINT NOT NULL,"workflow_enabled" BIGINT NOT NULL,"delivery_enabled" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),CHECK(id=1))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fee_history" ("category" TEXT NOT NULL,"old_fee" BIGINT NOT NULL,"new_fee" BIGINT NOT NULL,"conversion" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fee_state" ("category" TEXT NOT NULL,"fee" BIGINT NOT NULL,"window_offers" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"window_accepted" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("category"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feedback" ("need_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"success" BIGINT NOT NULL,"rating" BIGINT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("need_id","resource_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_checks" ("resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"outcome" TEXT NOT NULL,"status_code" BIGINT,"latency_ms" BIGINT,"error" TEXT,"observed_price" BIGINT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_vector_control" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"profile" TEXT NOT NULL,"descriptor_hash" TEXT,"descriptor_json" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_vector_generations" ("resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"generation" BIGINT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("resource_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_vector_heads" ("resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"job_id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("resource_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_vector_jobs" ("job_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"generation" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"source_hash" TEXT,"corpus_hash" TEXT,"descriptor_hash" TEXT,"token" TEXT,"fence" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"lease_until" DOUBLE PRECISION,"attempts" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"not_before" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"finished" DOUBLE PRECISION,"error_code" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("job_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_vector_provenance" ("resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"job_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"generation" BIGINT NOT NULL,"source_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"corpus_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"descriptor_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"vector_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"indexed_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("resource_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL,"value" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("key"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "needs" ("need_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"client" TEXT NOT NULL,"task" TEXT NOT NULL,"category" TEXT NOT NULL,"max_price" BIGINT,"networks" TEXT NOT NULL,"kinds" TEXT NOT NULL,"webhook" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"current_resource" BIGINT,"current_score" DOUBLE PRECISION,"free_used" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"ip" TEXT,"language" TEXT,"region" TEXT,"auth_pref" TEXT,"min_grade" TEXT,"usage_seen_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"rescanned_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("need_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "offers" ("offer_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"need_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"prev_resource_id" BIGINT,"score" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"prev_score" DOUBLE PRECISION,"teaser" TEXT NOT NULL,"fee" BIGINT NOT NULL,"free" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"decided_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"payer" TEXT,"tx_hash" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("offer_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "organization_workspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"name" TEXT NOT NULL,"active" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created_by" BIGINT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"updated" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("tx_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,"payer" TEXT NOT NULL,"service" TEXT NOT NULL,"amount" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("tx_hash"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "platform_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"ordinal" BIGINT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT,"protocol" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"error_code" TEXT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"dispatched" DOUBLE PRECISION,"finished" DOUBLE PRECISION,"elapsed_ms" DOUBLE PRECISION,"dispatch_to_result_ms" DOUBLE PRECISION,"transport_ok" BIGINT,"protocol_valid" BIGINT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("operation_id","ordinal"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "platform_credentials" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"key_name" TEXT NOT NULL,"key_value" TEXT NOT NULL,"provider" TEXT NOT NULL,"description" TEXT,"updated_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("key_name"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "platform_observation_events" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"event_key" TEXT NOT NULL,"operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"attempt_id" TEXT,"event" TEXT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"error_code" TEXT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("event_key"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "platform_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"kind" TEXT NOT NULL,"source" TEXT NOT NULL,"protocol" TEXT,"resource_id" BIGINT,"workflow_id" BIGINT,"parent_id" TEXT,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"error_code" TEXT,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"finished" DOUBLE PRECISION,"elapsed_ms" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "privacy_requests" ("id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,"request_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"created_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"request_type" TEXT NOT NULL,"visitor_token_masked" TEXT,"email" TEXT,"details" TEXT,"ip" TEXT,"user_agent" TEXT,"gpc_detected" BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',"statutory_deadline" DOUBLE PRECISION,"completed_at" DOUBLE PRECISION,"proof_hash" TEXT,"notes" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("request_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_claim_transfer_restore_blocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_claim_transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"source_workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"target_workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_control_claims" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status" TEXT NOT NULL,"created" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"expires" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"verified" DOUBLE PRECISION,"valid_until" DOUBLE PRECISION,"revoked" DOUBLE PRECISION,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public_availability_checks" ("checked_at" DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,"ok" BIGINT NOT NULL,"status_code" BIGINT,"latency_ms" DOUBLE PRECISION,PRIMARY KEY("checked_at"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_admission_policies" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_admission_restore_blocks" ("authority_id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("authority_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_admissions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"logical_key" TEXT NOT NULL,"snapshot_id" TEXT,"ticket_id" TEXT,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"),UNIQUE("ticket_id"),UNIQUE("snapshot_id"),UNIQUE("logical_key"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_circuit_claims" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id","source_ref"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_circuit_restore_blocks" ("authority_id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("authority_id"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_circuit_states" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"resource_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,"revision" BIGINT NOT NULL,"generation" BIGINT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("workspace_id","resource_id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_commands" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_consents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,"workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"cohort_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"payload" TEXT NOT NULL,"signature" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("id"))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reliability_controls_restore_blocks" ("authority_id" TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY("authority_id"))

AFTER UPDATE OF url,kind,usage_full_hash,usage_tools_hash,auth_info,auth_observed,active,health_status,usage_guide,details ON resources
WHEN OLD.url IS NOT NEW.url OR OLD.kind IS NOT NEW.kind OR OLD.usage_full_hash IS NOT NEW.usage_full_hash
 OR OLD.usage_tools_hash IS NOT NEW.usage_tools_hash OR OLD.auth_info IS NOT NEW.auth_info
 OR OLD.auth_observed IS NOT NEW.auth_observed
 OR OLD.active IS NOT NEW.active OR OLD.health_status IS NOT NEW.health_status
 OR OLD.usage_guide IS NOT NEW.usage_guide OR OLD.details IS NOT NEW.details
BEGIN DELETE FROM capability_eligibility WHERE resource_id=NEW.id; END;

statements.name: concierge/verification_summary.source.74ad95a1d0db
statements.postgres:
SELECT CASE v.profile_version WHEN 'a2a-sync-v1' THEN 'a2a' WHEN 'mcp-stateless-v1' THEN 'mcp' WHEN 'x402-probe-v1' THEN 'x402' ELSE 'other' END kind,e.outcome,COUNT(*) n
        FROM capability_evidence e JOIN connection_versions v ON v.id=e.version_id
        WHERE e.scope='execution' AND e.finished>=%s AND e.finished<=%s
          AND e.started>0 AND e.started<=e.finished
          AND e.outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','unknown')
        GROUP BY kind,e.outcome
statements.sqlite:
SELECT CASE v.profile_version WHEN 'a2a-sync-v1' THEN 'a2a' WHEN 'mcp-stateless-v1' THEN 'mcp' WHEN 'x402-probe-v1' THEN 'x402' ELSE 'other' END kind,e.outcome,COUNT(*) n
        FROM capability_evidence e JOIN connection_versions v ON v.id=e.version_id
        WHERE e.scope='execution' AND e.finished>=? AND e.finished<=?
          AND e.started>0 AND e.started<=e.finished
          AND e.outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','unknown')
        GROUP BY kind,e.outcome

statements.name: concierge/verification_summary.source.12b0faa13456
statements.postgres:
SELECT LEAST(23,TRUNC((finished-%s)/3600)::integer) bucket,
        e.outcome,COUNT(*) n FROM capability_evidence e
        JOIN connection_versions v ON v.id=e.version_id
        WHERE e.scope='execution' AND e.finished>=%s AND e.finished<=%s
          AND e.started>0 AND e.started<=e.finished AND e.outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','unknown')
        GROUP BY bucket,e.outcome
statements.sqlite:
SELECT MIN(23,CAST((finished-?)/3600 AS INTEGER)) bucket,
        e.outcome,COUNT(*) n FROM capability_evidence e
        JOIN connection_versions v ON v.id=e.version_id
        WHERE e.scope='execution' AND e.finished>=? AND e.finished<=?
          AND e.started>0 AND e.started<=e.finished AND e.outcome IN ('succeeded','failed','unknown')
        GROUP BY bucket,e.outcome

            JOIN connection_versions v ON v.id=p.version_id JOIN connection_agents a ON a.resource_id=v.resource_id
            LEFT JOIN capability_eligibility e ON e.resource_id=a.resource_id JOIN resources r ON r.id=a.resource_id
            WHERE p.contract_id=%s AND r.active=1 AND r.kind='mcp'
            GROUP BY a.resource_id ORDER BY MAX(e.executed_at) DESC,MAX(r.eval_score) DESC,a.resource_id DESC LIMIT 30

            WHERE p.contract_id=? AND r.active=1 AND r.kind='mcp'

statements.postgres:
SELECT g.id,g.next_run FROM workflow_connection_automation g
            WHERE g.active=1 AND g.next_run<=%s AND g.expires>%s AND g.used<((g.payload::jsonb)->>'max_runs')::bigint
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_publication_grants p WHERE p.id=g.release_id AND p.active=1 AND p.expires>%s)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_connection_automation_admissions a JOIN workflow_runs r ON r.id=a.run_id
                WHERE a.grant_id=g.id AND (r.status IN ('queued','running') OR r.execution_outcome='unknown'))
            AND (%s::text IS NULL OR g.next_run>%s OR (g.next_run=%s AND g.id>%s))
            ORDER BY g.next_run,g.id LIMIT 32
statements.sqlite:
SELECT g.id,g.next_run FROM workflow_connection_automation g
            WHERE g.active=1 AND g.next_run<=? AND g.expires>? AND g.used<json_extract(g.payload,'$.max_runs')
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_publication_grants p WHERE p.id=g.release_id AND p.active=1 AND p.expires>?)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_connection_automation_admissions a JOIN workflow_runs r ON r.id=a.run_id
                WHERE a.grant_id=g.id AND (r.status IN ('queued','running') OR r.execution_outcome='unknown'))
            AND (? IS NULL OR g.next_run>? OR (g.next_run=? AND g.id>?))
            ORDER BY g.next_run,g.id LIMIT 32

            m.role AS member_role,u.role AS user_role,u.updated_at AS user_updated
            FROM organization_workspaces w JOIN workspace_memberships m ON m.workspace_id=w.id
            JOIN admin_users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE w.id=%s AND w.active=1 AND m.user_id=%s
            AND m.active=1 AND m.role='owner' AND u.active=1 AND u.role IN ('admin','superadmin')

statements.name: vector.supersede_stale_heads.2
statements.postgres:
UPDATE legacy_vector_jobs SET status='superseded',finished=%s,lease_until=NULL
                WHERE job_id IN (SELECT j.job_id FROM (SELECT j.* FROM legacy_vector_jobs j
                JOIN legacy_vector_heads h USING(job_id)
                WHERE (j.status='pending' OR (j.status='claimed' AND j.lease_until<=%s)) AND j.resource_id IN (%s,%s) ORDER BY j.created,j.job_id LIMIT %s) j 
                LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id=j.resource_id
                LEFT JOIN legacy_vector_generations g ON g.resource_id=j.resource_id
                WHERE r.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.active,0)!=1 OR r.health_status='retired'
                    OR r.eval_security='quarantine' OR g.generation IS NULL OR g.generation!=j.generation)

UPDATE legacy_vector_jobs SET status='superseded',finished=%s,lease_until=NULL
                WHERE job_id IN (SELECT j.job_id FROM (SELECT j.* FROM legacy_vector_jobs j
                JOIN legacy_vector_heads h USING(job_id)
                WHERE (j.status='pending' OR (j.status='claimed' AND j.lease_until<=%s)) AND j.resource_id IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ORDER BY j.created,j.job_id LIMIT %s) j 
                LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id=j.resource_id
                LEFT JOIN legacy_vector_generations g ON g.resource_id=j.resource_id
                WHERE r.id IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.active,0)!=1 OR r.health_status='retired'
                    OR r.eval_security='quarantine' OR g.generation IS NULL OR g.generation!=j.generation)

statements.name: front.explore.count
statements.postgres:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM resources r WHERE r.active=1 AND r.health_status IN ('healthy','reachable') AND COALESCE(r.eval_security,'') != 'quarantine' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_eligibility ce
    JOIN connection_versions cv ON cv.id=ce.version_id AND cv.resource_id=r.id
    WHERE ce.resource_id=r.id AND ce.outcome='succeeded' AND cv.schema_complete=1
      AND ce.expires>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp())
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_evidence proof WHERE proof.version_id=ce.version_id
        AND proof.scope='execution' AND proof.outcome='succeeded' AND proof.finished=ce.executed_at)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_evidence newer WHERE newer.version_id=ce.version_id
        AND newer.scope='execution' AND (newer.finished>ce.executed_at OR
          (newer.finished=ce.executed_at AND newer.outcome!='succeeded'))))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM resources r WHERE r.active=1 AND r.health_status IN ('healthy','reachable') AND COALESCE(r.eval_security,'') != 'quarantine' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_eligibility ce
    JOIN connection_versions cv ON cv.id=ce.version_id AND cv.resource_id=r.id
    WHERE ce.resource_id=r.id AND ce.outcome='succeeded' AND cv.schema_complete=1
      AND ce.expires>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp())
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_evidence proof WHERE proof.version_id=ce.version_id
        AND proof.scope='execution' AND proof.outcome='succeeded' AND proof.finished=ce.executed_at)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_evidence newer WHERE newer.version_id=ce.version_id
        AND newer.scope='execution' AND (newer.finished>ce.executed_at OR
          (newer.finished=ce.executed_at AND newer.outcome!='succeeded')))) AND r.id IN (SELECT resource_id FROM agent_test_reports WHERE resource_id IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_test_reports tr WHERE tr.resource_id=r.id AND tr.kind=r.kind) AND r.kind=%s

          (newer.finished=ce.executed_at AND newer.outcome!='succeeded'))))

statements.name: front.insights
statements.postgres:
SELECT r.kind, COUNT(*) AS total,
                SUM((r.health_status IN ('healthy','reachable'))::integer) AS live,
                SUM((r.first_seen > %s)::integer) AS new_24h,
                SUM((r.first_seen > %s)::integer) AS new_7d,
                SUM((r.trial_ok = 1)::integer) AS verified,
                SUM((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_eligibility ce
    JOIN connection_versions cv ON cv.id=ce.version_id AND cv.resource_id=r.id
    WHERE ce.resource_id=r.id AND ce.outcome='succeeded' AND cv.schema_complete=1
      AND ce.expires>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp())
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_evidence proof WHERE proof.version_id=ce.version_id
        AND proof.scope='execution' AND proof.outcome='succeeded' AND proof.finished=ce.executed_at)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capability_evidence newer WHERE newer.version_id=ce.version_id
        AND newer.scope='execution' AND (newer.finished>ce.executed_at OR
          (newer.finished=ce.executed_at AND newer.outcome!='succeeded')))))::integer) AS execution_verified,
                SUM((COALESCE(r.auth_observed, r.auth_declared) = 0)::integer) AS no_auth,
                SUM((r.auth_autonomy = 'agent_autonomous')::integer) AS agent_autonomous,
                SUM((r.eval_grade = 'A')::integer) AS grade_a,
                SUM(r.cap_tool_count) AS tools,
                SUM(COALESCE(r.payers_30d, 0)) AS payers_30d,
                SUM(COALESCE(r.calls_30d, 0)) AS calls_30d,
                MIN(CASE WHEN r.price_usdc > 0 THEN r.price_usdc END) AS min_price,
                SUM((r.price_usdc > 0 AND r.price_usdc <= 10000)::integer) AS under_1cent,
                SUM((r.price_usdc > 0)::integer) AS priced
              FROM resources r WHERE r.active=1 AND r.health_status != 'retired' GROUP BY r.kind

SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.source, r.name, r.url, r.description, r.category, r.active, r.health_status, r.consecutive_failures,
                           r.last_check_at, r.last_ok_at, r.last_status_code, r.last_error, r.health_ok_24h, r.health_n_24h,
                           r.probe_latency_ms, r.eval_grade, r.eval_score, r.eval_security, r.trial_ok, r.price_usdc,
                           r.payers_30d, r.first_seen
                    FROM resources r WHERE r.active=%s AND r.health_status=%s AND (translate(r.name,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') LIKE translate(%s,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') ESCAPE '' OR translate(r.url,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') LIKE translate(%s,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') ESCAPE '' OR translate(r.description,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') LIKE translate(%s,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') ESCAPE '') ORDER BY COALESCE(r.payers_30d,0) DESC NULLS LAST, r.id LIMIT %s OFFSET %s

SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.source, r.name, r.url, r.description, r.category, r.active, r.health_status, r.consecutive_failures,
                           r.last_check_at, r.last_ok_at, r.last_status_code, r.last_error, r.health_ok_24h, r.health_n_24h,
                           r.probe_latency_ms, r.eval_grade, r.eval_score, r.eval_security, r.trial_ok, r.price_usdc,
                           r.payers_30d, r.first_seen
                    FROM resources r WHERE r.active=%s AND r.kind=%s AND r.health_status=%s ORDER BY translate(r.name,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') COLLATE "C" NULLS LAST, r.id LIMIT %s OFFSET %s

SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.source, r.name, r.url, r.description, r.category, r.active, r.health_status, r.consecutive_failures,
                           r.last_check_at, r.last_ok_at, r.last_status_code, r.last_error, r.health_ok_24h, r.health_n_24h,

SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.source, r.name, r.url, r.description, r.category, r.active, r.health_status, r.consecutive_failures,
                           r.last_check_at, r.last_ok_at, r.last_status_code, r.last_error, r.health_ok_24h, r.health_n_24h,
                           r.probe_latency_ms, r.eval_grade, r.eval_score, r.eval_security, r.trial_ok, r.price_usdc,
                           r.payers_30d, r.first_seen
                    FROM resources r WHERE r.active=%s AND r.kind=%s AND r.health_status=%s AND r.category=%s AND r.source=%s AND r.eval_grade=%s AND (translate(r.name,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') LIKE translate(%s,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') ESCAPE '' OR translate(r.url,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') LIKE translate(%s,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') ESCAPE '' OR translate(r.description,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') LIKE translate(%s,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') ESCAPE '') ORDER BY translate(r.name,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') COLLATE "C" NULLS LAST, r.id LIMIT %s OFFSET %s

statements.name: admin.needs
statements.postgres:
SELECT n.need_id, n.client, n.task, n.category, n.status, n.created, n.updated, n.rescanned_at,
                                    n.current_score, n.max_price, n.networks, n.kinds,
                                    r.id AS current_resource_id, r.name AS current_name, r.url AS current_url, r.kind AS current_kind,
                                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offers o WHERE o.need_id=n.need_id) AS offers
                             FROM needs n LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id=n.current_resource
                             
                             ORDER BY n.created DESC LIMIT %s OFFSET %s

statements.name: admin.insights
statements.postgres:
SELECT r.kind, COUNT(*) AS total,
                            SUM((r.health_status IN ('healthy','reachable'))::integer) AS live,
                            SUM((r.first_seen > %s)::integer) AS new_24h,
                            SUM((r.first_seen > %s)::integer) AS new_7d,
                            SUM((r.trial_ok = 1)::integer) AS verified,
                            SUM((COALESCE(r.auth_observed, r.auth_declared) = 0)::integer) AS no_auth,
                            SUM((r.auth_autonomy = 'agent_autonomous')::integer) AS agent_autonomous,
                            SUM((r.eval_grade = 'A')::integer) AS grade_a,
                            SUM(r.cap_tool_count) AS tools,
                            SUM(COALESCE(r.payers_30d, 0)) AS payers_30d,
                            SUM(COALESCE(r.calls_30d, 0)) AS calls_30d,
                            MIN(CASE WHEN r.price_usdc > 0 THEN r.price_usdc END) AS min_price,
                            SUM((r.price_usdc > 0 AND r.price_usdc <= 10000)::integer) AS under_1cent,
                            SUM((r.price_usdc > 0)::integer) AS priced
                          FROM resources r WHERE r.active=1 AND r.health_status != 'retired' GROUP BY r.kind

SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.source, r.name, r.url, r.description, r.category, r.health_status, r.price_usdc,
                   r.payers_30d, r.calls_30d, r.eval_grade, r.eval_score, r.trial_ok, r.cap_tool_count, r.first_seen,
                   r.auth_method, r.auth_autonomy, COALESCE(r.auth_observed, r.auth_declared) AS auth_required FROM resources r WHERE r.active=1 AND r.health_status IN ('healthy','reachable') AND COALESCE(r.eval_security,'') != 'quarantine' AND r.category=%s AND r.trial_ok=1 AND (COALESCE(r.auth_observed, r.auth_declared, 0)=0 OR r.kind='x402') AND r.kind=%s
                                ORDER BY r.first_seen DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN r.trial_ok=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, COALESCE(r.eval_score, 0) DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT %s
statements.sqlite:
SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.source, r.name, r.url, r.description, r.category, r.health_status, r.price_usdc,
                   r.payers_30d, r.calls_30d, r.eval_grade, r.eval_score, r.trial_ok, r.cap_tool_count, r.first_seen,
                   r.auth_method, r.auth_autonomy, COALESCE(r.auth_observed, r.auth_declared) AS auth_required FROM resources r WHERE r.active=1 AND r.health_status IN ('healthy','reachable') AND COALESCE(r.eval_security,'') != 'quarantine' AND r.category=? AND r.trial_ok=1 AND (COALESCE(r.auth_observed, r.auth_declared, 0)=0 OR r.kind='x402') AND r.kind=?
                                ORDER BY r.first_seen DESC, (r.trial_ok IS 1) DESC, COALESCE(r.eval_score, 0) DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT r.id, r.kind, r.name, r.url, r.category, r.description, r.eval_grade, r.eval_at, r.eval_score, r.eval_security, r.eval_info FROM resources r
            WHERE r.eval_at IS NOT NULL AND r.eval_score IS NOT NULL
